title: WPSS/1373/2013 of Sanjay Kumar Verma Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1373 of 2013
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
None for the petitioner.
Ms. Jyoti Joshi, Advocate holding brief of
Mr. Ashish Joshi, Advocate for respondent no. 1
and 2.
For the reasons stated, delay condonation
application no. 9550 of 2013 is allowed. Delay in
filing the substitution application is condoned.
This is an application for substitution of
legal heirs of respondent no. 3. For the reasons
stated, substitution application no. 8787 of 2013 is
allowed.
Let amended memo of petition be filed
within a week.
Issue notice to newly impleaded
respondent by registered post AD in addition to
normal mode of service on steps being taken by the
petitioner within a week after the amended memo is
filed.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 20.12.2013
SKS
